notes: Multi-step tasks now show a clean progress timeline. When Rounds files your documents or works out your next steps, each stage appears as a labelled step on a green timeline — instead of raw tool output. ⌘+ / ⌘− zoom now also scales the chat itself (your messages, the AI's answers, and the input box), not just the rest of the app. And the Home box always opens a chat now — the old 'concerns' symptom tracker was removed.
